1.consolidated_definition: Planta con tallos de cerca de 1m de altura, de flores blanquecinas y fruto rojo amarillento con grandes semillas en forma de almendra; se emplea en la medicina popular. (Balsaminaceae, Quamoclit vulgaris).
1.en_consolidated_definition: Plant with stems approximately 1m in height, bearing pale white flowers and a reddish-yellow fruit containing large almond-shaped seeds; used in folk medicine (Balsaminaceae, Quamoclit vulgaris).
